$Comment: Putting on a Santa Suit. The suit is spent first, and only a suit actually spent pays: ModifyInventory takes one from the hand, and only its Next pays the Costume reward (ZigGrantReward), which puts Christmas_Costume_Santa on the player who used it. When the costume cannot go on, the reward pays its FallbackLootable instead (Christmas_Santa_Suit_Return), which hands the suit back, so a suit is never lost. Change how long it lasts in the costume effect, never here.
